response.name: Email Already Registered - OTP Sent

request.description: Step 1 of app launch. Returns registered=false (show registration form) or registered=true and emails a 6-digit OTP (valid 10 min, resend allowed after 60s). Without SMTP configured, the OTP is printed in the backend log.

response.name: Not Registered
Registered - OTP Sent

request.description: Step 2 for registered users. Verifies the OTP (max 5 attempts) and returns customer, outlets, installation and license details (same shape as /register success). Errors: 401 INVALID_OTP, 429 OTP_ATTEMPTS_EXCEEDED.
Validates a serial license key for offline Mobile POS verification.
